Scan Subject ID: OAS1_0457_MR1 | Protocol: OASIS-1
Patient Demographics: 62-year-old female.

Ventricular Morphology: Slightly enlarged lateral and third ventricles with minimal ventricular cap volume expansion.

Summary Impression: Structural brain MRI demonstrates preserved intracranial parenchyma without focal neurodegeneration.
